name: otc-contract-integration-tests
description: Integration tests for Taostats OTC smart contracts

scripts.test:localnet:flaky: node scripts/run-localnet-tests.mjs --restart file --repeat 3 src/tests/alpha-listing.test.ts src/tests/trading.test.ts src/tests/claim-dividends.test.ts src/tests/subnet-risk.test.ts src/lockup-listings/create-listing.test.ts src/lockup-listings/take-listing.test.ts src/lockup-listings/cancel-listing.test.ts src/lockup-listings/claim.test.ts
scripts.generate-contract-types: papi ink add ../target/ink/otc_contract/otc_contract.contract --key otc_contract && papi ink add ../target/ink/alpha_lockup/alpha_lockup.contract --key alpha_lockup && papi ink add ../target/ink/lockup_listings/lockup_listings.contract --key lockup_listings
